name: SN-SVM Color and Opacity Assignment
aliases: HSV-based Color Assignment with Gradient Factor
definition: A method for assigning color (Hue, Saturation, Value) and opacity to voxel groups identified by SN-SVM classification, designed to enhance visual aesthetics, contrast, and boundary details without ad-hoc user input.
summary: SN-SVM Color and Opacity Assignment is an image-centric method that enhances visual aesthetics and boundary details using HSV-based color and gradient-modulated opacity without ad-hoc user input.
